title: reseda elata var. malvalii
intro: Reseda elata var. malvalii, commonly known as the White Mignonette or White Reseda, is a plant species known for its delicate white flowers and aromatic foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions, thanks to its numerous health benefits such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Reseda elata var. malvalii include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
